description: Connection and stream parameters of the LSM9DS1 inertial sensor board (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer) read through a microcontroller serial board that also carries a lidar. Units follow UCUM (https://ucum.org). Connection and stream start are manual from the panel, never at app startup.

subject.description: Serial board (unknown firmware) exposing a LSM9DS1 inertial sensor and a lidar; protocol observed, not documented by the manufacturer

rate_hz.description: null keeps the board's persistent rate; the stream is capped at 25 Hz as soon as the lidar is active
